title: jahaa'n me aaya hai noore paikar
body:
jahaa'n me aaya hai noore paikar hassan ka dilbar hassan ka dilbar
ye dusri hai shabihe haidar hassan ka dilbar hassan ka dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan se kehti hai umme farwa, nazar na lag jaaye isko moula
hai qubsurat qamar se badhkar hassan ka dilbar hassan ka dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
pidar ne taweez jo hai likhha, dilayega isko izn ran ka
ladega ab ye hassan hi bankar hassan ka dilbar hassan ka dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hamza jaffer sa tera rutba, wo sheh ki nusrat me tera jazba
ajal ko samjha shahad se badh kar hassan ka dilbar hassan ka dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
jari ki mehnat ali ke tewar, yahi hai dulha ke aaj zewar
dikhayega sab wegha ke jouhar hassan ka dilbar hassan ka dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
barasti thi tegh ban ke bijli, amaa'n laeenou ko kuch na milti
tha ran pe chaya wo mout ban kar hassan ka dilbar hassan ka dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
gire jo arzaq ke chaar bete, to uske sathi ye us se bole
hai sin me chota ye hai ghazanfar hassan ka dilbar hassan ka dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
jo qatl arzaq ko kar ke chode, to hath abbas ne the choome
ke taaza kardi hai yaade hyder hassan ka dilbar hassan ka dilbar
